description: React component for a single value selector with optional filtering and creation capabilities, used in access control table editing within Mattermost's admin console.

methods.name: commitInputValue
methods.description: Handles committing the input value when editing or adding a new value.

methods.name: handleKeyDownSimpleInput
methods.description: Handles key down events for the simple input, commits value on Enter.

methods.name: onFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter state based on user input.

methods.name: handleSelectItem
methods.description: Handles selection of an existing option.

methods.name: handleCreateValue
methods.description: Creates a new value based on user input.

methods.name: handleInputKeyDownForMenu
methods.description: Handles key events within the menu input, including creating new values.
